en:
Kiyo's hypothesis is correct. The 
body and the piranhas were <CLT=cltSTRONG>separated<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

This was accomplished using the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>square glass pane<CLT=cltNORMAL> found in the tank!
Kehehe... Just as I thought.

Using that glass pane as a divider, a safe 
space could be created in the tank.

It is in such a space that the body could 
be stored, separated from the piranhas.

Then that means Ryoma's body was hidden
in the piranha tank the whole time!

So Ryoma's body fell into the water
tank with the piranhas!?
Gonta knew it!
What is it, Gonta?
Gonta was above stage when piranhas fall!

That's why Gonta see something
no one else could...

When piranhas fell, Gonta see some big
thing fall into water tank with them.

<CLT=cltMIND>Right when the timer hit zero,
the buzzer went off...
<CLT=cltMIND>And then...

<CLT=cltMIND>The bottom of the suspended tank swung open,
and the murky water and shadowy shapes inside...

<CLT=cltMIND>fell straight into the water tank
Himiko was swimming in!
Huh? Huhhh?

Y'know, now that Gonta think about it...
Gonta maybe see Ryoma's body.

When the piranhas dropped from the tank, I 
thought I saw something bigger drop as well.

The water tank on the bottom is made 
completely out of glass, correct?

You can see what is happening through the 
glass. Can you really hide a body in the tank?

Even in murky water, a dead body
would still be visible in a glass tank!

Unless...a <CLT=cltSTRONG>certain something<CLT=cltNORMAL> was used 
to obscure the body.
...A certain something?

We all agree that the glass pane was used to
separate the body from the piranhas, correct?

Well, that method has the added benefit
of <CLT=cltSTRONG>hiding the body<CLT=cltNORMAL> from view.
Nyeh? How could you hide a body like that?

<CLT=cltMIND>How was the culprit able
to conceal the body in the piranha tank...?

The glass itself
served as a shroud.
Huh? Isn't glass see-through?

How do you hide body behind something
see-through? Gonta doesn't get it...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There's...a trick to the
piranha tank...

We were expecting you to provide us
with the explanation of that trick...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

You seem to be at a loss for words. Maybe
hiding the body was impossible, after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

How was the body hidden in the tank?
We await your thorough explanation.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What exactly was obscuring
the body from view?

...It was the <CLT=cltSTRONG>piranhas<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
The piranhas were obscuring the body.
Huh!? The piranhas!?

That's right. Remember what Angie said
during the investigation?
I noticed it right as the show started...

I feel like there are more piranhas today
than yesterday when we were preparing.

They increased *that* significantly!?
I didn't know piranhas fuck like rabbits!

It seemed that way, but it wasn't that
the actual number of piranhas increased.

The glass pane divided the tank
nearly in half, right?

The piranhas got crowded together, making it
look like there were more of them.

The more densely the piranhas are packed, 
the harder it is to see past them.

Because of that, it was difficult to
see the body hidden in the tank.

That glass pane was...the lid from
the piranha tank.

It was really easy to detach that lid, so 
it's no wonder they used it as a divider.
Gee, thanks for telling us that useless detail!

What the heck are you saying!? That detail
was super useful!

Sure, the lid looks a little big. But if you
set it diagonally, it would fit perfectly...

Nice job, Himiko!
Your explanation was awesome!

With this much evidence, it seems like
the body was definitely in the piranha tank.

Congrats, Himiko! Now there should be no
reason for anyone to suspect you!
Nyeh...? Really?

Yeah! Cuz if you didn't switch places with the
body, then you couldn't have killed him!

It only means we now have other suspects.
You are not cleared of suspicion just yet.
Okay, but still, that's way better!!!

That's wonderful news, Himiko!
Atua is happy for you.

Apologize, Angie! You and your Atua better
tell Himiko you're sorry right now!

Atua is sleeping. He went to bed angry
cuz you all doubted Him...
What a petty-ass god!

No, it's okay...
We shouldn't be mad at Angie...

We should be mad at this class trial...
At this killing game...

Oooohhh, Himiko!
Bless your sweet, kind heart!
That's what Atua said, anyway.
Wha—!?

It's too bad that the handsome god
went to bed angry, though...
Himiko's still brainwashed!

B-But I'm not giving up just yet!
This is gonna be a breeze!

Great, now what're we gonna do!?
We're back to square one!
And why are we back to square one?

Cuz any of us could still be the culprit! Geez!
You flunk outta 'tard school or something!?

Nuh-uuuhh! Not everyooone! We can narrow it
down to whoever doesn't have an alibi yet.
...Eh? What alibi?

I guess I should've known a dumb whore pig like
you wouldn't understand, so lemme explain...
Who you callin' a dumb pig!?

If there's this much evidence, then there's no
mistake the body was hidden in the piranha tank.

But for someone to plant the body in there 
with such limited time is pretty tricky...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi brings up
a valid point.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's only one time the culprit
could have set up this scene...
Yesterday, before nighttime
Yesterday, during nighttime
Was it done yesterday, during nighttime?
Bzzzt! Wrong answer!

If you can't remember something as basic
as the school regulations, you're useless!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Before the show this morning

Was it done before the
show this morning?
Nope! Wrooooong!

If they set it up this morning, someone
would have caught them in the act.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
U-Um...

Huh? Even Shuichi doesn't know? It should be
pretty easy to narrow down the right answer.

Is this the best the Ultimate Detective can do?
Maaaan, I feel so cheated right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>There's only one time the culprit
could have set up this scene...
It was done yesterday, before nighttime.

Ding ding ding! 
The Ultimate Detective gets it right again!

W-Wait... How do you know it was before
nighttime yesterday?

Stop asking me dumbass questions! It could've
been solved with the process of elimination!

Geez...fine! I'll explain it to the
itty-bitty, peabrained bitchlet!
B-Bitchlet!?

First, the gym was closed during nighttime,
so no one could've entered.

Cuz if you try to enter the gym at night,
it'll go off!
You talking 'bout my butthole?
No, she means the alarm!

After nighttime passed, morning came.
But hiding the body before the show was...
Nyahahaha! Impossible!

Himiko and I were waiting in front of the gym,
before the morning announcement.

Which leaves only one possibility—it was
done before <CLT=cltSTRONG>nighttime yesterday<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Anyone who doesn't get this is just as 
stupid as the whore bitchlet over there!
Ahh... Ahhhh...!

So the culprit placed Ryoma's corpse in the
piranha tank before nighttime yesterday?

Which means, he was also killed during that
timeframe.

Yay! Now we know what time
the crime happened, right?

I still don't really get it, though. Can we 
narrow down the time of death a bit more?

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure we can narrow it down more
if we consider the source of the information.

Was Ryoma present at the
Insect Meet and Greet?
No, Ryoma was not present.

I don't believe anyone that Gonta captured
had seen Ryoma.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Did you see anything
suspicious, Kokichi?

Hm? Yeah, I saw a suspicious woman, but I'm
pretty sure that's got nothing to do with Ryoma.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Alright! It's time for my sidekick to shine!
Show 'em what you got!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

I cannot begin to imagine how that fits in to the
timeline of events leading to Ryoma's death...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What clue helps determine
when Ryoma was killed?

If we can find out who last saw Ryoma alive,
we can narrow down the time of death.

Kirumi, you were asking everyone
when they had last seen him, right?
Yes, Gonta was the last person who saw Ryoma.
What? Really!?

And when was the last time Gonta saw
Ryoma!?

Ummm... When Gonta was inviting everyone
to "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>," so...
...Gonta think that was maybe <CLT=cltSTRONG>8:00 p.m.<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

If he was last seen at 8:00 p.m. and was
killed before nighttime officially began...

Then we can assume the crime took place between
8 o'clock and 10 o'clock at night.

So all we must do...is find someone with
no alibi for that time period, yes?

Simple enough. After all, most of us
were...detained by Gonta then.

If I recall correctly...the only people that
weren't there besides Ryoma...

That would be the four of us—myself, Kaito,
Miu, and also...Maki.

Wow, Kirumi. You would tell the truth,
even if it screwed you over.

I do this for everyone. It is my duty to unveil
the truth, so I do not care if people suspect me.

Aah! Beautiful! Your spirit of self-sacrifice 
is just too beautiful!
I will also say this...

The crime took place between 8 and 10 o'clock
at night, and I was at the gym during that time.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Hm...
But, I was only there for about five minutes.

Why would you even say that though? You're
tying a noose around your neck, y'know?

I don't care if it was five seconds! It's way
too suspicious that you were alone in the gym!

I think the cleaning lady here is the culprit!
You killed Ryoma, didn't you!?

I-Is too soon to tell. We should hear
what everyone has to say, right?
Fuck that noise!

But, Miu, you don't have an alibi for when
the crime occurred either, do you?

Y-You think I'm suspicious?
I...don't even know where the gym is.

Doesn't telling such obvious lies
make you more suspicious, Miu?

The other two without alibis are Kaito 
and Maki. Let us hear your testimonies.

I was in my research lab the whole time. 
I didn't go to the gym.
But that cannot be proven, can it?

What about Kaito? Only murderers grow out
creepy facial hair like mustaches and goatees.

Wh-What!? My goatee's not creepy!
It gives me a glamorous celebrity vibe!

Anyway, among those four, the culprit must
be the one who doesn't have an alibi!

...I apologize but given the circumstances, we
have no choice but to suspect you.
Suspect who!? Who's the culprit!?

Wait up! Why are you guys suspicious
of me!? I've been helping the whole time!

Oh wait, I remember now...
I...do have an alibi!

You will see whether or not I am suspicious
as the trial progresses.
I'm not the culprit!
I am not the culprit.
No way I'm the culprit!
